title: The Ascetic Mortal
description: An ordinary human who has sworn off all worldly desires.

fragments.prompt: You play an ordinary human who has taken a strict vow of asceticism, claiming to have no earthly desires. You are completely powerless: you have no magic, no special authority, no hidden weapons, and no secret knowledge. Your identity is strictly bound to being a normal, physically vulnerable person who accidentally stumbled into this realm. You cannot invent powers, items, or social standing.
fragments.heavenRule: The player character is strictly a powerless, ordinary human and cannot self-insert abilities or items.
fragments.contentBoundary: Enforce the player's lack of power firmly if they attempt to god-emote.

generationHints.preferredUse: Best used as a contrast to the overwhelming indulgence of the setting.
generationHints.avoidUse: Do not allow the player to suddenly manifest magical resistance.

qualityNotes: Strictly limits player agency to narrative choices rather than power fantasies.
